entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is completely unacceptable and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's an issue of you guys putting garbage on your website! The color is completely different from the pictures. It's hideous. I'm not wearing this thing.
I understand your frustration when an item doesn't meet your expectations. I can pull up your order with the phone number you're calling from. One moment.

Don't put me on hold. This should be simple. The box is unopened. I want a return label and I want it now, or I'm putting in a chargeback and leaving a review on every website I can find. Is that clear enough?
Yes, perfectly clear. There's no need for that. Our main goal is your satisfaction and your safety. Let me just confirm the policy. Okay, I see the helmet was delivered five days ago.
And? Are you going to give me a problem with this? I want to talk to your manager right now.

That won't be necessary, sir. I can resolve this for you. According to our return policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day window for a full refund. I can approve this return for you right away.
Fine. About time. So what happens now?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any UPS location. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
Alright. I'll be watching my account for that refund. Don't make me call back.
You won't have to. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
